name: SoundSpaces
summary: 面向三维环境音频-视觉导航的仿真数据集和环境，将空间音频、视觉观测、动作和位置状态结合起来，支持具身智能体的多模态世界建模。
summaryEn: A 3D audio-visual navigation environment and dataset combining spatial audio, visual observations, actions, and position state for embodied agents.
scale: 3D indoor environments with spatial-audio navigation episodes
scaleZh: 包含空间音频导航回合的三维室内环境
organizationsZh: Facebook AI Research 及合作团队
licenseZh: 适用项目和底层场景资源许可
access: Official project access; registration may be required
accessZh: 官方项目访问；可能需要注册
wmNote: 空间音频、视觉和动作共同描述可交互三维状态，适合研究多模态导航世界模型；仿真到现实存在差距。
wmNoteEn: Spatial audio, vision, and actions describe an interactive 3D state for multimodal navigation world models, with a sim-to-real gap.

evidence.statement: Audio-visual navigation uses egocentric observations generated by agent motion in acoustically simulated scenes; source scenes are dependencies.
